items.html: Let us now return to explain the matter of the coupling of AA, what it served for, and what phase is made through it in ZON. It has been explained above that ZA, in his entirety, is no less than VAK, and no more than them, until he grows through the second Ibur [impregnation]. Now, indeed, for the purpose of this coupling of AA, ZA is included three within three, as above, for it cannot be said that through the Ibur three extremities were subtracted from him and he remained with only three, for this is inconceivable; rather, the three were included within three, as above.
